def priority(item, bins):
    s = bins - item
    r = s % 25
    return -np.minimum(r, 25 - r).astype(float) - 0.01 * s
C6.idea: Quarter-capacity residual alignment: leave slack near a multiple of 25 (Harmonic-like granularity)

C7.idea: Fill-level threshold: nearly full bins (remaining<=30) best-fit first, otherwise worst-fit

C8.idea: Last-fit: prefer newest open bin (Next-Fit-like recency)

C9.idea: Dead-zone avoidance: exact fit best, avoid leaving slack 1-9, otherwise worst-fit

C10.idea: Median-balancing: choose bin whose remaining capacity is closest to the median of feasible bins

C11.idea: Three-class size policy: small best-fit, medium exact-fit-else-first-fit, large first-fit

C12.idea: Bounded first-fit: first bin leaving slack <= item size, else worst-fit
